Chalazia

In an uncontrolled series of 22 patients and 26 eyes, 12 eyes resolved after one low-level-light treatment followed by medication, 24 after a second, and two required incision and curettage.

PBM Database summary

What the records report

In an uncontrolled series of 22 patients and 26 eyes, 12 eyes resolved after one low-level-light treatment followed by medication, 24 after a second, and two required incision and curettage.

Summary of the Evidence

One unique human publication reports a retrospective uncontrolled series of 22 patients and 26 eyes. No independent clinical replication, animal study, or laboratory experiment was identified. The distinction between patient and eye counts matters because some participants contributed both eyes.

Human and clinical evidence

Stonecipher and Potvin reported that 12 of 26 eyes resolved after one treatment and 24 of 26 after a second; two eyes required incision and curettage. Low-level light was followed by a standard pharmaceutical regimen, and there was no untreated, sham, or medication-only comparator. The series therefore describes outcomes after combined care but cannot isolate the effect of PBM or distinguish it from spontaneous resolution and medication (Stonecipher & Potvin 2019).

Animal evidence

No relevant animal study was identified.

In-vitro and ex-vivo evidence

No standalone laboratory evidence was identified.

Treatment Parameters and Generalizability

The article reports a 15-minute low-level-light treatment. Other settings, including wavelength and dose, are not supplied here because they were not verified in the source. The treatment was an adjunct to medication in a retrospective eye-clinic series; it does not establish the same effect for light alone or in another setting.

Interpretation

The report provides an observed resolution count after combined treatment, but the absence of a comparator prevents a causal estimate. Independent controlled evidence is not present in this category.

Evidence strength in source summaryLesion resolution after adjunctive low-level light and medication: Very low
Publications and records1 unique title

Evidence strength rationale and next steps

One retrospective uncontrolled series reported resolution in many treated eyes, but participants also received medication and there was no sham, untreated, or medication-only group. Several participants contributed both eyes, so eye counts are not independent patient counts. A prospective controlled study with lesion-level follow-up is needed.

Publication and study types

  • Human retrospective uncontrolled series1, 22 patients and 26 eyes
  • No randomized trial, animal, or in-vitro study.
